command:
THERMO_VERIFIED_SDK_PATH="$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path)" || exit "$?"
export SDKROOT="$THERMO_VERIFIED_SDK_PATH"
mkdir -p .remote-qa
uname -a > .remote-qa/environment.txt
xcrun swift --version >> .remote-qa/environment.txt
printf "%s\n" "$DEVELOPER_DIR" "$SDKROOT" >> .remote-qa/environment.txt
xcrun --show-sdk-version >> .remote-qa/environment.txt
git rev-parse HEAD >> .remote-qa/environment.txt
swift test --jobs 2 --skip HardwareTests > .remote-qa/test.log 2>&1
result=$?
tail -n 35 .remote-qa/test.log
printf '%s\n' "$result" > .remote-qa/exit-code.txt
exit "$result"
